find:
GUARD_ROOT_INPUT=${CONTROL_ROOM_GUARD_ROOT-}
  case "/$GUARD_ROOT_INPUT/" in */../*|*/./*) exit 70 ;; esac
  GUARD_ROOT_CANONICAL=$(cd "$GUARD_ROOT_INPUT" 2>/dev/null && /bin/pwd -P) || exit 70
  [ "$GUARD_ROOT_CANONICAL" = "$GUARD_ROOT_INPUT" ] || exit 70
  case "$GUARD_ROOT_CANONICAL" in /private/tmp/*|/Volumes/CRRehearsal/*) ROOT=$GUARD_ROOT_CANONICAL ;; *) exit 70 ;; esac
why: the guard test seam must reject dot-dot traversal even when it canonicalises back inside an allowed root

find:
await rm(path, { force: true });
    await writeFile(path, `#!/bin/sh\n${body}\n`, { mode: 0o500, flag: "wx" });
why: reinstalling read-only fake commands must not make a marked rehearsal root one-shot
concurrent same-root runs must produce a stable typed busy refusal rather than raw EEXIST
real-root mode must use a child install directory and never the rehearsal volume root itself
a stopped rehearsal process must not leave a permanent root lock that blocks a safe retry
